set -eu cat >/tmp/inventory_app.py <<'PYAPP' #!/usr/bin/env python3 import json import os import socket from http.server import BaseHTTPRequestHandler, ThreadingHTTPServer BACKEND = os.environ.get("BACKEND_NAME", socket.gethostname()) INVENTORY = [ {"sku": "HW-100", "name": "Widget", "quantity": 42}, {"sku": "HW-200", "name": "Gadget", "quantity": 17}, {"sku": "HW-300", "name": "Sprocket", "quantity": 8}, ] class Handler(BaseHTTPRequestHandler): server_version = "InventoryApp/1.0" def send_body(self, status, content_type, body): payload = body.encode("utf-8") self.send_response(status) self.send_header("Content-Type", content_type) self.send_header("Content-Length", str(len(payload))) self.send_header("Cache-Control", "no-store") self.send_header("X-Backend-Server", BACKEND) self.end_headers() self.wfile.write(payload) def do_GET(self): path = self.path.split("?", 1)[0] if path == "/healthz": self.send_body(200, "text/plain; charset=utf-8", "healthy backend=" + BACKEND + "\n") elif path == "/api/inventory": self.send_body(200, "application/json", json.dumps({"application": "inventory", "backend": BACKEND, "items": INVENTORY}) + "\n") elif path == "/": rows = "".join("{sku}{name}{quantity}".format(**item) for item in INVENTORY) page = """Inventory

Inventory Web Application

Served by: {}

{}
SKUItemQuantity
""".format(BACKEND, rows) self.send_body(200, "text/html; charset=utf-8", page) else: self.send_body(404, "text/plain; charset=utf-8", "not found\n") def log_message(self, fmt, *args): print("%s - %s" % (self.address_string(), fmt % args), flush=True) ThreadingHTTPServer(("0.0.0.0", 8080), Handler).serve_forever() PYAPP cat >/tmp/inventory-app.service <<'UNIT' [Unit] Description=Inventory web application After=network-online.target Wants=network-online.target [Service] Type=simple Environment=PYTHONUNBUFFERED=1 ExecStart=/usr/bin/python3 /opt/inventory/inventory_app.py Restart=always RestartSec=2 User=www-data Group=www-data NoNewPrivileges=true PrivateTmp=true ProtectSystem=strict ProtectHome=true [Install] WantedBy=multi-user.target UNIT sudo -n install -d -o root -g root -m 0755 /opt/inventory sudo -n install -o root -g root -m 0755 /tmp/inventory_app.py /opt/inventory/inventory_app.py sudo -n install -o root -g root -m 0644 /tmp/inventory-app.service /etc/systemd/system/inventory-app.service sudo -n systemctl daemon-reload sudo -n systemctl enable --now inventory-app.service systemctl is-active inventory-app.service systemctl is-enabled inventory-app.service ss -tlnp | grep ':8080' curl -fsS -D - "http://$NODE_IP:8080/healthz"
